name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus) — 1 Basic — Omophagy

system.description: By making eye contact and winning a Mental Challenge, the thaumaturge imbues her target with an all-consuming gluttony; mortals gorge themselves sick, while Kindred drain a vessel dry and attempt to devour its flesh (without any diablerie occurring by accident). A hungry vampire confronted by blood enters hunger frenzy, though a Willpower Trait may stave off the urge for one scene. This power lasts the rest of the night. Kindred who begin this path automatically lose one permanent Willpower Trait as they become addicted to its hedonistic pleasures. This path retests with the Occult Ability.
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus)
